post.summary: Read a document again

post.description: OWNER and ADMIN only. The values in the body (type, certificate number, holder, issuer, validity) become the document's real fields; they are the person's, whether they kept the proposal, corrected it or typed them. Each field is recorded as ACCEPTED, EDITED or ADDED against the reading's proposal. Works the same for a document the reading could not read (manual entry). Writes a DOCUMENT_VERIFIED event on the step. The reading itself is not changed.
